stemMarkdown: The average of 12 numbers is 48. When one more number is included, the average becomes the sum of all 13 numbers divided by 13. If the new number added is 125, find the new average (rounded to 2 decimal places).
solutionMarkdown: Sum of original 12 numbers $= 12 \times 48 = 576$. New sum $= 576 + 125 = 701$. New average $= \dfrac{701}{13} = 53.92$.
